mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and enoxaparin use suggests potential pregnancy risk or thrombotic conditions; isotretinoin may rarely increase bleeding tendency through effects on platelet function and clotting factors.
action: Ensure strict contraception in females of childbearing potential taking isotretinoin; monitor for unusual bleeding or bruising; use enoxaparin only if absolutely necessary for thrombotic indication with rigorous pregnancy prevention compliance.
